comments.body:
Grades are one thing. 

Write a convicing 1-2 pages research proposal long you can defend. Show that matter is important and worth investigation.

Make it specific, measurable, attainable, relevant, and time-bound so you could actually write a thesis with results in it and be done with your PhD in 4-5 years.

Make it as flawless as you can, formatted like a research paper with Latex, relevant bibliography, etc.

Email researchers / lecturers / professors that do work in what you're interested in and ask for a meet up. If they like what you cooked up in your proposal, they'll let you know and invite you to for chat (ideally). If they do, show in person you really understand the domain at a graduate level. Last but not least - read some relevant papers / chapters / books of the researchers that invited you.
comments.author: SidereusEques
